body:
### Summary

A managed Python installation counts as installed as long as its directory is there. After the interpreter executable disappears from an otherwise intact installation, every uv command that selects it fails with `Python interpreter not found`, and `uv python install` exits 0 without repairing it. The missing file is `cpython-3.12.15-linux-x86_64-gnu/bin/python3.12` on Linux and `cpython-3.12.15-windows-x86_64-none\python.exe` on Windows; every other file of the installation is still in place, so the directory still looks complete.

### Reproduction

```console
$ export UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR=/tmp/r/python UV_PYTHON_BIN_DIR=/tmp/r/bin UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/r/cache
$ export PATH=/tmp/r/bin:$PATH
$ uv python install 3.12
Downloading cpython-3.12.15-linux-x86_64-gnu (download) (32.7MiB)
 Downloaded cpython-3.12.15-linux-x86_64-gnu (download)
Installed Python 3.12.15 in 612ms
 + cpython-3.12.15-linux-x86_64-gnu (python3.12)
$ rm /tmp/r/python/cpython-3.12.15-linux-x86_64-gnu/bin/python3.12
$ uv run --no-project --managed-python --python 3.12 python -c "print('ok')"
error: Python interpreter not found at `/tmp/r/python/cpython-3.12.15-linux-x86_64-gnu/bin/python3.12`
$ uv python install 3.12
Installed Python 3.12.15 in 24ms
 + cpython-3.12.15-linux-x86_64-gnu (python3.12)
$ uv run --no-project --managed-python --python 3.12 python -c "print('ok')"
error: Python interpreter not found at `/tmp/r/python/cpython-3.12.15-linux-x86_64-gnu/bin/python3.12`
$ uv python install --reinstall 3.12
Downloading cpython-3.12.15-linux-x86_64-gnu (download) (32.7MiB)
 Downloaded cpython-3.12.15-linux-x86_64-gnu (download)
Installed Python 3.12.15 in 562ms
 ~ cpython-3.12.15-linux-x86_64-gnu (python3.12)
$ uv run --no-project --managed-python --python 3.12 python -c "print('ok')"
ok
```

Both `uv run` invocations exit 2. The second `uv python install 3.12` exits 0 and downloads nothing. `uv sync` fails the same way, and without `--managed-python` uv falls through to a system interpreter, so nothing reports the broken installation. 0.12.23 and current main (3d9ce3cb) behave the same.

### Expected

`uv python install 3.12` repairs the installation, and `uv run` downloads it again, as both do when the directory is absent.

### Cause

`ManagedPythonDownload::fetch_from_url` returns `AlreadyAvailable` for any existing directory, `uv python install` satisfies a request on a key match alone (`InstallRequest::matches_installation`), and discovery yields `installation.executable()` without checking that the file exists. The missing executable surfaces only when `Interpreter::query` tries to spawn it.

### Workaround

`uv python install --reinstall 3.12`, or `uv python uninstall 3.12` and install again.

I have a fix ready and will open a pull request.

Related: #19622 (dangling minor-version junction on Windows), #19329 and #20309 (installation published before finalization).


### Platform

Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64 (WSL2); also reproduced on Windows 11 x86_64

### Version

uv 0.13.1 (62faed335 2026-10-13)

### Python version

Python 3.12.15
title: `uv python install` does not repair a managed installation whose interpreter executable is missing
